study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective registry
outcome: Time to reach target hypothermia temperature
cohort: 150 newborns (68 outborn) treated with therapeutic hypothermia, prospectively enrolled in the Vermont Oxford Neonatal Encephalopathy Registry from January 2008 to October 2016.
finding: Outborn infants needing therapeutic hypothermia showed a lack of cord gas values and took longer to reach target temperature, suggesting remediable differences in care that contribute to poorer outcomes.
cross-section timing: Data collected from January 2008 to October 2016
